```powershell
Write-Output '=== SEAT 504 - PROGRESSION MADE VISIBLE (Ground: the census read the whole quest system and the progression is real - a phi ladder of levels, XP for every beat, gold, a six stage chain that turns on touch - and every bit of it prints only into the log file, where no player ever sees it. That is the exact address of the verdict that the game has no progression: the gains land in silence. This job routes the same events to the screen through one small helper seated in the quest system itself: every XP gain, every level up, every fragment count, and every stage turn now shows in gold text in the game while it happens, on the same lines that already write the log. Eight call sites, each anchored on a line the census printed, all counted before a byte moves, verified by read back, and the build runs in this same job when the editor stands closed. Every variable carries the p504 prefix.) ==='
$p504b64 = ''
$p504py = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'patch504.py'
[IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($p504py, [Convert]::FromBase64String($p504b64))
$p504exe = 'C:\Users\Admin\AppData\Local\Microsoft\WindowsApps\python.exe'
& $p504exe $p504py
$p504ed = Get-Process -Name ('UnrealEdito' + [char]114) -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
if ($p504ed) {
  Write-Output 'BUILD HELD - editor open, patch stands written'
  Write-Output 'PHI P504 VERDICT: SEATED BUILD HELD'
} else {
  $p504bat = 'C:\Program Files\Epic Games\UE_5.8\Engine\Build\BatchFiles\Build.bat'
  $p504uproj = 'D:\VEIL-OMNI\VEIL.uproject'
  $p504log = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'build504.log'
  & $p504bat VEILEditor Win64 Development -Project="$p504uproj" -WaitMutex -NoHotReload *> "$p504log"
  Select-String -Path $p504log -Pattern 'Result:|Warning: |Total time' | Select-Object -Last 8 | ForEach-Object { Write-Output ('BLD ' + $_.Line.Trim()) }
  Write-Output 'PHI P504 VERDICT: BUILD READ DONE'
}
Write-Output 'JOB 504 DONE'
```
